commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "4e2bf05aca4b60115da6c1584920f6ee278e3534"
git mv frontend/src/components/content/contentBlocks.ts frontend/src/components/content/contentBlockUtils.ts
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('frontend/src')
replacements = {
    'content/contentBlocks': 'content/contentBlockUtils',
    './contentBlocks': './contentBlockUtils',
}
changed = []
for path in root.rglob('*'):
    if path.suffix not in {'.ts', '.tsx'}:
        continue
    text = path.read_text()
    new = text
    for old, repl in replacements.items():
        new = new.replace(old, repl)
    if new != text:
        path.write_text(new)
        changed.append(path.as_posix())
print('updated_import_files=' + ','.join(changed))
PY
if git grep -n -E '["'"'](\./|\.\./|\.\./\.\./).*contentBlocks["'"']' -- frontend/src; then echo 'stale contentBlocks import remains'; exit 31; fi
git diff --check
cd frontend
npm ci
npm run typecheck
VITE_API_BASE_URL= npm run build
cd ..
git status --short
git add frontend/src
git commit -m 'Fix content block module casing for macOS'
git push origin HEAD:work/fix-content-block-case-collision
